name: right-red
title: Then It Has to Fail, for the Right Reason
kicker: Red first · and the right red
html:
Then It Has to Fail, for the Right Reason

Red, but not evidence

The step that reads the policy file doesn’t exist yet. The run fails, and says nothing about renewals.

The right red

The old code always moves three weeks. Zero weeks expects 2026-11-12, gets 2026-12-03. Six weeks expects 2026-12-24, gets 2026-12-03.

Every Run Through the Runner

A raw test command is blocked; it would leave nothing in the log. Each run leaves one line: pass or fail, total, failures. No results at all is logged as a failure, with the reason.

gate-bash.sh bdd-run-logging.gradle.kts
say: Next, the scenario has to fail before any code changes. That sounds simple. Here's the trap. If the step that reads the policy file doesn't exist yet, the run fails, and that's red, but it isn't evidence of anything about renewals. It's evidence that a step is missing. The right red is this: with the old code, every renewal moves three weeks, so the zero-weeks row expects the 12th of November and gets the 3rd of December, and the six-weeks row expects Christmas Eve and gets the 3rd of December too. That's the behavior missing, exactly where the table says it should be. The skill makes this checkable. Tests only run through its runner; a raw test command is blocked, because it would leave nothing in the log. Every run leaves one line: pass or fail, the total, the failures. And a run that produced no results is logged as a failure, with the reason, so it can't pass for the real thing.

deck:ref.label: RIGHT-BEHAVIOR
deck:ref.title: Right behavior: only what the state allows, and a reason when not
deck:ref.summary: The agent is offered only the acts the current state allows, sends each one with the validator from the state it read, and gets a reason when an act is absent. At the small scale it is a Gherkin scenario that says what right means before any code is written.

deck:fragment.name: bash-gate
deck:fragment.label: Raw test commands are blocked (core/gate-bash.sh)
deck:fragment.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# PreToolUse (Bash). For wrapper-logged stacks: blocks running the raw test
# command, because a raw run leaves no BDD_RUN fact and the pre-commit check
# then cannot see the red/green sequence. No-op unless bddRawCommandRegex is set.
set -o pipefail
. "$(dirname "$0")/lib.sh"

bdd_has_config || exit 0
regex=$(bdd_value bddRawCommandRegex)
[ -n "$regex" ] || exit 0

command=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')
[ -n "$command" ] || exit 0
case "$command" in *bdd-gates/bdd-run.sh*) exit 0 ;; esac

if printf '%s\n' "$command" | grep -Eq -- "$regex"; then
  echo "Blocked: run tests through .claude/bdd-gates/bdd-run.sh [extra args] so the BDD_RUN result is logged." >&2
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
